entries.text: Check technical terms in an Article or selected passage with sourced, advisory findings. Review the evidence and decide what to change; the check does not rewrite your text.
Quick Actions now shows your five most recently used built-in Skills first, with a control to browse all Skills or return to recent ones. Skill names now describe their writing tasks more clearly.
New Author guides cover writing and organizing Articles, reviewing changes, translations, Style Profile, and application settings.
